packageRules.description: Patch updates are low risk and can merge themselves. Overridden for Cilium below.
Group minor bumps of the supporting stack into one reviewable PR.

Cilium is the CNI and the kube-proxy replacement. A bad upgrade takes cluster networking with it, so it is never automerged and always lands on its own. Listed last so it overrides the patch-automerge rule above.
Flux's own controllers are upgraded with `flux bootstrap`, which rewrites gotk-components.yaml. Renovate must not edit that file or the two will fight.
